hero.title: We Build Websites That Work
hero.body: Blue Canary Web Design is a small studio focused on clear, honest websites for small businesses and mission-driven organizations.

story.title: Who We Are
paragraphs: Blue Canary Web Design partners with small businesses and organizations across a wide range of industries. Whether you run a local shop, a professional service, or a mission-driven organization, our focus is the same: clear, honest, well-crafted websites that help you grow.

Our services include custom website design, redesigns of outdated sites, performance and accessibility improvements, mobile-first layouts, and ongoing support. We take a practical, collaborative approach and aim to build sites that are easy to maintain, fast to load, and effective for real people.

items.title: Clarity Over Cleverness
items.body: Your website should communicate clearly, not show off. We prioritize messaging that connects with real people over flashy gimmicks.

items.title: Honest Communication
items.body: We'll tell you what you need, not what costs the most. Transparency in pricing, process, and expectations is non-negotiable.

items.title: Accessible to Everyone
items.body: Every website we build follows accessibility best practices. Good design means design that works for everyone.

items.title: Supporting Good Work
items.body: We offer discounted pricing for organizations focused on democracy, equality, and human kindness. Good web design shouldn't be out of reach for people doing good work.

cta.title: Let's Work Together
cta.body: Ready to talk about your website? We'd love to hear about your business and how we can help.
